entities.name: AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network when authentication fails, particularly with 5GMM cause #71 'ngKSI already in use'.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network in response to successful authentication validation.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message
entities.description: Message from network containing EAP-request message and ngKSI for authentication.

entities.name: Timer T3520
entities.description: Timer started by UE when sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message with cause #71.

entities.name: Retransmission timers T3510, T3517, T3521
entities.description: Retransmission timers that are stopped and potentially restarted during authentication procedures.

entities.name: 5GMM cause #71 'ngKSI already in use'
entities.description: Authentication failure condition where the ngKSI provided by network is already in use.

entities.name: Network authentication check failure
entities.description: Condition where UE deems that network has failed authentication check.

entities.name: Current TAI not in TAI list
entities.description: Condition where current Tracking Area Identity is not present in UE's TAI list.

entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure for mobility and periodic registration update initiated by UE.

entities.name: EAP based primary authentication and key agreement procedure
entities.description: Authentication procedure using EAP protocol for primary authentication and key agreement.

entities.name: Security mode control procedure
entities.description: Procedure executed when network passes authentication check during emergency service.

entities.name: Registered for emergency services
entities.description: UE property indicating it is registered for emergency services.

relations.description: Authentication failure with ngKSI already in use triggers sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message.
Sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message starts timer T3520.
Sending AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message stops running retransmission timers.
Receiving valid AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message stops timer T3520 if running.
Valid AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message triggers sending AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message.
Sending AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message starts previously stopped retransmission timers.
TAI not in list condition establishes initiation of registration procedure.
Network authentication failure condition starts previously stopped retransmission timers.
Timer T3520 expiration guards network authentication failure condition.
Security mode control procedure stops timer T3520.
EAP authentication procedure during emergency service establishes UE registration for emergency services.
